name: eRX / eR9 road electronic
use_case: Road 2× electronic shifting with hydraulic disc brakes
positioning: eRX is the carbon flagship; eR9 is the lower-cost aluminium entry system with separate calipers.

shifting.max_rear_sprocket_note: The official 2024 catalog generation lists 11-32T, but the current upgraded eRX/eR9 maximum is not stated clearly enough to carry that number forward.

architecture: Semi-wireless: both levers send wireless commands; front and rear derailleurs draw power through wires from one seat-tube battery.

weight.note: The official 2024 catalog lists 225 g per lever, 270 g rear derailleur, 135 g front derailleur and 118 g per caliper. It does not give a safe current-generation total.

battery: Official manual/catalog generation: internal 7.4 V, 800 mAh battery; current range and charge time are not stated on the current product overview.
controls_and_app: L-TWOO app supports speed selection, micro-adjustment and firmware updates; optional flat-bar and time-trial controls are part of the Electric ecosystem.
package_summary: The official manual package includes two levers, front and rear derailleurs, two hydraulic calipers, internal battery, two power wires, charger, hardware and mineral brake fluid.

compatibility.frame: Internal seat-tube battery fit and two power-wire routes
compatibility.brake_fluid: L-TWOO O ONE mineral brake fluid; do not substitute DOT

china_price_status: A bounded manual Taobao search on 2026-08-24 required sign-in and exposed no attributable exact-kit card; mainland price remains open.
caveats: Confirm the exact generation, maximum rear sprocket, rear-cage range and battery-mount fit before ordering.
The system requires internal power-wire routing and a workable seat-tube battery mount.
Use the specified L-TWOO mineral brake fluid rather than DOT fluid.
